name: intraday_trend_following_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: Strong intraday trends in Nifty50 stocks persist due to herding behavior and information cascades. When price is above both EMA(20) and EMA(50) on 1-min, and the 20 is above the 50, pullbacks to the EMA(20) offer high-probability continuation entries. Institutional order flow that initiated the trend continues to provide bids/offers during pullbacks. Edge persists because most retail traders either chase momentum too late or fade it too early.
stock_filter: top 25 by avg daily turnover, avg daily range > 1%

long.confirmation: bar closes above ema_20 after touching it

short.confirmation: bar closes below ema_20 after touching it

exit.stop_loss: 1.0 * atr_20 from entry or close below ema_50 (whichever is tighter)
exit.trailing_stop: trail by 1.0 * atr_20 after +1.0 * atr_20 profit
exit.signal_exit: close below ema_50 (for longs) or above ema_50 (for shorts)

filters.time_filter: no entries in first 30 min (need trend to establish) or last 30 min

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — trend following is structural; herding behavior is persistent

weaknesses: Sub-50% win rate means long drawdown periods; need strong conviction to keep trading through losses
ADX > 25 filter on 1-min bars is slow to react — trend may reverse before ADX catches up
On choppy days, false trends form and collapse, generating multiple small losses
prior_art: EMA pullback trend following — standard trend-following concept adapted for 1-min intraday
notes: Consider Supertrend indicator as an alternative trend filter for faster adaptation.
